operating_notes.text: Company wrote off receivables of ₹723.48 million and wrote back liabilities of ₹68.40 million in Q4FY26.
Secured new orders worth ₹4,500 Cr in Q4 FY2026, taking total order book above ₹13,000 Cr.
Secured new orders worth ₹6,500 Cr consolidated in FY 25-26, taking total order book to ₹13,000 Cr.
Entered into a contract agreement with Rail Vikas Nigam Limited for ₹588.57 Cr residential EPC order in Chhattisgarh.

timeline.summary: Ramky Infrastructure announced postal ballot voting results on April 24, 2026, approving related-party transactions for FY27 and subsidiary loan guarantees.
Ramky Infrastructure received an RoC notice under section 210 for information covering FY15 to FY22.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹506.68 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹42.95 Cr (against a loss of ₹4.65 Cr a year earlier).
Ramky Infrastructure reported FY2026 consolidated PAT of ₹283 Cr, up 40% YoY, and an order book exceeding ₹13,000 Cr.
Ramky Infrastructure released its investor presentation for FY26 reporting consolidated revenue of ₹1,846 Cr and an order book of ₹13,000 Cr.
Ramky Infrastructure entered into a contract agreement with Rail Vikas Nigam Limited for a ₹588.57 Cr residential EPC order in Chhattisgarh.
